plugins.name: headroom
plugins.description: Keeps the orchestrator's context small: tier rules every session, model and effort checks on Agent and Workflow spawns, a Haiku scout, and once-per-prompt nudges when the main session reads or edits too much itself.

plugins.name: writing
plugins.description: Writing skills for prose people read: technical blog posts, technical primers, and rewriting copy so it sounds human instead of corporate.

plugins.name: deepen
plugins.description: Rewrites a task prompt into a deeper version at the same scope, held to the standard a top practitioner of the field would apply.

plugins.name: consolidate-plans
plugins.description: Consolidates implemented superpowers plans and specs into project documentation, and reports which plans are implemented and which are still open.
